docs.summary: ErrorPage component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use ErrorPage to communicate status or feedback to users. This component provides visual indicators that help users understand the current state or outcome.
ErrorPage is effective for showing status, progress, or results. Use it consistently throughout your application to maintain clear communication patterns.

anatomy.description: ErrorPage is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate severity
bestPractices.description: Match the error-page visual style to the message importance.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing too many error-page instances at once.

bestPractices.title: Provide context
bestPractices.description: Include clear, actionable information in the error-page.

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistency
bestPractices.description: Use the same patterns throughout your application.
